{{Coins|168}} & {{Exp|56}} (Hard) |mode_type = Adidas2026 |waves = 20 |health = 100 |level_requirement = None |starting_cash = Solo: *{{Money|2,500}} *{{Money|2,600}} (Group Bonus) Duo: *{{Money|2,400}} *{{Money|2,500}} (Group Bonus) Trio: *{{Money|2,200}} *{{Money|2,300}} (Group Bonus) Quad: *{{Money|2,000}} *{{Money|2,100}} (Group Bonus) |music-1 = '''Wave 1-18''' [[File:⏰ONE HOUR⏰ OF PHOQUS 💀OHIO💀 TYPE BEATS🗣️🔥🔥|250px|center|thumb|Beat 7]] |music-ingame-1 = '''Wave 1-18''' [[File:Tower Defense Simulator OST - Adidas Victory Field (Ohio Type Beats Volume 1 - Beat 7)|250px|center|thumb]] |music-2 = '''Wave 19-20''' [[File:⏰ONE HOUR⏰ OF PHOQUS 💀OHIO💀 TYPE BEATS🗣️🔥🔥|250px|center|thumb|Beat 8]] |music-ingame-2 = '''Wave 19-20''' [[File:Tower Defense Simulator OST - Adidas Boss (Ohio Type Beats Volume 1 - Beat 8)|250px|center|thumb]] }} ==Description== '''Victory Field''', internally referred to as '''Map3Adidas''', was a map located in a city soccer court. It was the event map for the third mission of the [[Backyard Legends Event]]. Like other event maps, this map had a specialized wave structure with special enemies. Players start with a varying amount of cash, based on the player count. It has no unique rewards. You only got cash if an enemy is killed, or in some cases, damaged by a specific amount of health. Additionally, the amount gained was a set amount of cash, which was not always equal to the enemy's health. Enemies split their cash between players, regardless of how much damage the player dealt to it. If, in a duo, one player did all the damage to an enemy, both players would received 50% of the cash the enemy would normally give in solo. This means that in solo, you received 100% of the cash when an enemy is killed, or it was damaged enough. With each additional player, this was reduced to 50% in duo, 33% in trio and 25% in quad. If it was a decimal number, it got rounded up or down depending on the decimal value. If it was at least 0.5, it gets rounded up. If it was less than 0.5, it got rounded down. All difficulties had health scaling of 10% in trio matches and 20% in quad matches. The [[Commander]]'s ''Support Caravan'' ability was also disabled. In the Hard difficulty, [[Mutation]] was applied, which increases the health of an enemy by 10% every wave after its first appearance, also boosting rewards by 20%. In both difficulties, players could not use their [[Skills]] or consumables. ==Design & Path== '''Victory Field''' was a soccer court placed in the middle of a city. The court had a green floor with white lines and was surrounded by tall metal fences on the sides and taller ones on the front and back. Behind the fences there was audience seats to sit on and bystanders watching the court. On the front and back there were stairs leading out of the court. Next to them were a few trees. These stairs lead to the city itself, which contained multiple colorful buildings with billboards on them which display Roblox ads. The path started at one goal to the other. The path went in a straight line and entered a u-shaped portion of the path. Then it lead into two straights which lead into a loop. Out of that loop were a few remaining straight paths leading to the exit. ==Interactive Map== {{Map:Victory Field}} ==Preset Loadouts== This map only had one preset loadout with no option to choose your own. Because of this, every player would use the following loadout. {{PresetLoadout |Name = Dream Team |SlotLink1 = [[Assassin]] |Icon1 = CrewAssassinIconIG.png |SlotLink2 = [[Demoman]] |Icon2 = CrewDemomanIconIG.png |SlotLink3 = [[Trapper]] |Icon3 = CrewTrapperIconIG.png |SlotLink4 = [[Militant]] |Icon4 = SuperFanMilitantIconIG.png |SlotLink5 = [[Commander]] |Icon5 = RefereeCommanderIconIG.png }} ==Rewards== The game calculated how many {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Exp|}} you received based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 100% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned was multiplied by 2x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplied any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts were additive. Rewards were calculated as: {| class="tds-table pad-10" style="text-align: center; margin:1em auto" !Coins Reward !EXP Reward |- ! colspan="2" |Easy Rewards |- |({{Coins|45}} ÷ (1 + [(20 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]^1.3) + {{Coins|15}} (Triumph Bonus)) × 1.2 |(Waves Completed × {{Exp|1}}) × 1.2 |- ! colspan="2" |Hard Rewards |- |({{Coins|80}} ÷ (1 + [(20 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]^1.3) + {{Coins|30}} (Triumph Bonus)) × 1.4 |(Waves Completed × {{Exp|1.5}} + {{Exp|10}} (Triumph Bonus)) × 1.4 |} Triumphing '''Victory Field''' could give out an additional reward, which could be a crate, consumable or ticket. The reward given was based on difficulty selected. They were meant to be guaranteed, though due to a bug this did not always happen. Additionally, items were sometimes not given out. These items were: {{Tabber |Easy |*{{Color|Common}} (40%) **[[Grenade]] (1-2) **[[Flash Bang]] (1-2) **[[Molotov]] (1-2) *{{Color|Uncommon}} (40%) **{{TimeScaleTicket|Time Scale Ticket}} **{{ReviveTicket|Revive Ticket}} *{{Color|Rare}} (20%) **[[Low Grade Crate]] **{{SpinTicket|Spin Ticket}} **[[Barricade]] **[[Supply Drop]] **[[AirStrike]] |Hard |*{{Color|Common}} (50%) **{{TimeScaleTicket|Time Scale Ticket}} **{{ReviveTicket|Revive Ticket}} **[[Grenade]] (1-3) **[[Flash Bang]] (1-3) **[[Molotov]] (1-3) *{{Color|Uncommon}} (20%) **[[Low Grade Crate]] **{{SpinTicket|Spin Ticket}} **[[Barricade]] (1-2) **[[Supply Drop]] (1-2) **[[AirStrike]] (1-2) *{{Color|Rare}} (20%) **[[Mid Grade Crate]] **[[Napalm Strike]] **[[Blizzard Bomb]] **[[UAV]] *{{Color|Legendary}} (10%) **[[High Grade Crate]] }} ===Badges=== There are also a few [[badges]] which can be obtained when playing this map. These are: {{Badge |title = Mission 3 Easy |ID = Adidas3E |description = Defeat Felipe on Mission 3 Easy |image = BackyardLegends3Easy.png |obtainable = Yes }} {{Badge |title = Mission 3 Hard |ID = Adidas3H |description = Defeat Felipe on Mission 3 Hard |image = BackyardLegends3Hard.png |obtainable = Yes }} ==Wave Structure== The formula for calculating wave bonus on each wave was: :({{Money|750}} + ([Waves Completed - 1] × {{Money|200}})^1.13) × (1 - [Players - 1] * 0.03) The wave clear bonus appeared when every enemy from that wave was killed. It was 35% of the wave bonus in solo matches and 20% of the wave bonus in duo or higher matches. The waves in '''Victory Field''' followed these timings: {| class="wikitable align-center" style="width:50%; margin:1em auto" !Waves !Wave Timer !Skip TimeHow long you have to wait before you can skip. |- |1-14 |1:00 |0:19Skip at 0:40. |- |15-19 |1:15 |0:19Skip at 0:55. |- |20 |∞ |N/A |} '''Bolded''' names indicate an enemy type's debut.

==Strategy== *The [[Assassin]], [[Militant]] and [[Trapper]] can be pretty effective at taking out enemies. **The [[Trapper]] can be also used to stall them with its bear traps. **The [[Commander]] can be used to boost the DPS of your towers. ***The ''Support Caravan'' ability cannot be used as it has been disabled here. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Development Images}} VictoryFieldDI.png|'''Victory Field''' on a development image. }} ==Trivia== *The path has a similar layout to [[Northern Lights]] if the first loop is removed, however, most of the paths have different length from the ones in [[Northern Lights]]. ==Update History== *'''22 May 2026''' - [[v1.91.0]] **'''Competition Court''' added. **{{Bug}} First music track does not play. *'''22 May 2026''' - [[v1.91.0|v1.91.2]] **{{Bugfix}} First music track now plays. *'''25 May 2026''' - [[v1.91.0|v1.91.3]] **Rewards nerfed. *'''12 June 2026''' - [[V2.0.0|v2.0.9]] **'''Victory Field''' removed. ==Notes== {{BackyardLegendsMaps|[[Competition Court]]|Mission 2|Victory Field|Mission 3|End|N/A}} {{MapNavBox}}
